Entries.Text: Lists every map part that uses a model, grouped by map. Click a part to load its map in the Map Editor and select it. The maps are read once, in the background, into an index; the maps themselves aren't kept.
The model name as map parts give it: c4100, AEG099_090, or for map pieces the MSB's name (m001000 in Elden Ring, not the file name). Use Loaded Model works this out.

Reads the project's maps (with the game's for those it doesn't change). Off reads only the game's maps. Changing this builds the index again.
Matches every model whose name contains the text (c41 finds c4100, c4110...), instead of the exact name.
Search the index, or read the maps again first.
Lists the parts using the model. The first search reads every map, which takes a while in the larger games.
Reads every map again, to include changes saved since, then searches.
